name: Choice Chews | 200mg Gummies | Pineapple Mango Coconut
description: What better way to escape to a tropical paradise than with the exotic flavor of Choice Chews' Pineapple Mango Coconut gummies! We blended the sweet juiciness of pineapple and mango with the creamy richness of coconut and enhanced it with the uplifting power of sativa to transport you to an island getaway with every bite.
